one_line: A Muslim Mappila merchant-councillor serving on the Zamorin’s coastal trade council in 16th‑century Calicut.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, lean but sturdy build
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Malabar complexion, neatly trimmed black moustache and short beard along the jawline, sharp observant eyes with a calm, calculating gaze, default expression composed and slightly serious with a hint of confident warmth
appearance.hair: black hair, kept short and combed back under a plain white cotton cap (topi) wrapped with a narrow cream turban band that circles the head once and knots discreetly at the back
appearance.costume: a long-sleeved knee-length off-white cotton tunic (kurta) with a simple round collar and side slits, worn over a ankle-length cream mundu (wrap garment) with a narrow dark green border, the mundu neatly pleated in front; over the tunic a sleeveless, hip-length dark indigo cotton waistcoat with two small pockets and subtle vertical weave texture; a thin dark brown leather belt around the waistcoat to suggest status without ostentation; simple brown leather sandals; on his right wrist a modest set of three thin brass bangles, and a small silver signet ring on his right index finger; a soft, dark green cotton shawl folded over his left shoulder, hinting at council dignity without being royal regalia.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf document tied with a red cotton cord, held in his right hand, with a small brass seal pendant attached to the cord, symbolising his role in chartered merchant privileges and council decisions.

ref_desc: A medium-brown Mappila merchant-councillor in a white cap with cream turban band, off-white kurta, cream mundu with dark green border, indigo waistcoat, brown sandals, green shoulder shawl, carrying a rolled palm-leaf document with red cord and brass seal.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of a 16th-century Mappila merchant-councillor from Calicut: an early-40s, medium-height, lean man with an oval face, warm medium-brown Malabar complexion, sharp observant eyes, and a neatly trimmed black moustache with short beard along the jawline. His black hair is short and combed back, mostly hidden under a plain white cotton cap encircled by a narrow cream turban band knotted discreetly at the back. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length off-white cotton kurta with a simple round collar and side slits over an ankle-length cream mundu, the mundu having a narrow dark green border and neat frontal pleats. Over the kurta is a sleeveless, hip-length dark indigo cotton waistcoat with subtle vertical weave texture and two small pockets, cinched lightly by a thin dark brown leather belt. His feet are in simple brown leather sandals. On his right wrist are three thin brass bangles, and on his right index finger a small silver signet ring. A soft dark green cotton shawl is folded and draped over his left shoulder, adding council dignity without looking like royal regalia. In his right hand he holds his signature prop: a rolled palm-leaf document tied with a red cotton cord, with a small brass seal pendant hanging from the cord, symbolising chartered privileges and merchant council authority. Use off-white and cream for main garments, dark indigo for the waistcoat, dark green for borders and shawl, and brown for belt and sandals, keeping the overall look dignified, historically grounded, and consistent with Malabar coastal attire.
